name: University College Dublin
description: University College Dublin is a public research university in Dublin, founded in 1854 by John Henry Newman as the Catholic University of Ireland. It is one of Ireland's largest universities, with over 12,000 international students on its Belfield campus.
whyIncluded: UCD reports 39 Singaporean students on its Dublin campus and over 20 years of delivering degrees in Singapore through partners, its MB BCh BAO is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications, and it was among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents).

livingCosts.notes: UCD Global 'Estimated Monthly Living Costs (Per Student)', median column, last updated April 2026: accommodation EUR 1,200 + utilities EUR 135 = housing; food EUR 490; local travel (Leap Card) EUR 75; personal = books and copying EUR 120 + clothing and hygiene EUR 150 + internet and mobile EUR 45 + personal/social EUR 120 + miscellaneous EUR 110. UCD's median total is EUR 2,445 a month (range EUR 1,735-4,035). Excludes residence permit, health insurance, flights and one-off set-up costs. www.ucd.ie returns 403 to the scraper's user agent; read with a browser user agent.

programmes.name: BSc Computer Science (DN201)
programmes.notes: UCD Registry non-EU undergraduate fee table for 2026/27 (the table embedded in ucd.ie/students/fees/noneucoursefees/internationalnon-euundergraduatefees202627/). Published fees include the Student Centre Levy; the EUR 5 AMLE (students' union) levy is charged on top. UCD states that a student who starts a multi-year programme on a non-EU rate keeps that fee for the programme, so the fee is cohort-locked.
